title: web-ai-showcase conformance-migration record (conformance-migrations.json)
description: One record per exceptional change to an IMMUTABLE conformance assertion (web-ai-showcase-9tw). The label is the audit trail, so it must state intent honestly: 'remove' = the assertion no longer applies; 'weaken' = genuine reduction in coverage; 'correct' = the assertion was derived from WRONG metadata and the demo was always honest. Default to fixing the DEMO, not the assertion. Every record carries a substantive reason and a date; 'weaken' and 'correct' must also cite evidence, because a deviation from immutability has to be demonstrated rather than asserted. Values here mirror CONFORMANCE_MIGRATION_ACTIONS in scripts/conformance-lib.mjs, which is the single source of truth (a test fails if the two lists drift).

suiteId.description: Conformance suite id — the demo slug (matches models/<slug>/conformance.json .id).

assertionId.description: Id of the assertion being changed, as it appears on origin/main.

action.description: 'remove' deletes an assertion, 'weaken' reduces coverage, 'correct' fixes an assertion that was factually wrong (requires evidence).

reason.description: Substantive explanation of why the assertion had to change. An unargued record is not a record.

evidence.description: Required for 'weaken' and 'correct': where the proof lives (file, run record, measurement) and what it shows.

date.description: ISO date the change was authorised.

fromTest.description: Previous assertion test text/values, for a content change.

toTest.description: New assertion test text/values, for a content change.

fromSuiteHash.description: suiteHash of the suite as it stands on origin/main.

toSuiteHash.description: suiteHash after the change — validateSuite recomputes and requires stored == computed.
